author: PackRat 🐀
name: XENEON EDGE Ultimate
description: One native XENEON EDGE dashboard for the information that matters most. Home combines time, weather, PC health, media, schedule and connection status. Performance adds native iCUE FPS, automatically selected CPU/GPU sensors and rolling history. Today combines agenda, focus and a pinned note. Ambient keeps the display useful without visual noise. Smart Mode can enter Performance when iCUE reports an active FPS session and returns to the normal dashboard afterward. Core operation is local-first and does not require a PackRat cloud account.
